target: 100% completion of the selected Windows Ultimate HD Edition route plus the documented Wii pointer-control sample, spoiler-free

areas.name: Selected PC Route and Wii Control Sample
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, clean save directory, first playable room, and a separate Wii pointer test.
areas.note: Establish a stable original-2005 route without importing unlocks.

items.label: Use Ultimate HD Edition on Windows

levels.1: The selected native-PC release already contains the later bonus campaigns and modes.
levels.2: Install the Windows Ultimate HD Edition and create a clean local save.
levels.3: Verify the 2005 game, not the 2023 remake, is installed, disable imported unlock saves, confirm controller prompts and audio, start at 30 fps for testing, and create a baseline save before adding any restoration files.

levels.1: The chosen fidelity route restores assets while preserving the original game.
levels.2: Install the current RE4 HD Project over a clean Ultimate HD Edition copy.
levels.3: Back up the unmodified install, follow the project's version-matched installer, keep its bundled fixes together, launch once, compare the title and first playable room, and retain a rollback copy. Do not mix remake assets into this route.

levels.1: A short stress test prevents a late save or timing failure.
levels.2: Test 60 fps, QTE input, cutscenes, inventory, and saves before the completion run.
levels.3: Run through combat, a door transition, an inventory rearrangement, a merchant menu, a QTE, and a typewriter save. Reload twice. If timing or physics misbehaves, use the HD Project's recommended compatibility options or return to 30 fps.

levels.1: One secondary edition changes aiming rather than adding a separate campaign.
levels.2: On a lawful Wii disc or tested Dolphin setup, complete one combat area with pointer aiming.
levels.3: Keep this save separate from PC completion. Calibrate the sensor or emulated pointer, test firearm aim, knife input, QTE gestures, inventory control, and companion commands, then finish one safe encounter and view the Wii-specific credits option. No second full campaign is required.

levels.1: Mode unlocks and New Game Plus all depend on a small set of save files.
levels.2: Keep pre-finale, cleared Normal, cleared Professional, and bonus-mode saves separately.
levels.3: After each major region, copy the save directory with the game closed. Preserve distinct baselines for first-run treasure cleanup, Professional, New Game Plus purchases, Separate Ways, Assignment Ada, and Mercenaries; never overwrite the only pre-transition file.

save_backup.title: Preserve the unmodified baseline
save_backup.why: Restoration files and completion saves must remain reversible.

areas.name: Campaign and Difficulty Progression
areas.location_cue: The three broad physical regions, merchant network, result screen, and cleared-file continuation.
areas.note: Complete every built-in campaign difficulty and post-game continuation.

levels.1: The selected PC edition includes a lower-resource-pressure route worth recording separately.
levels.2: Start a new Easy file and reach its completion save.
levels.3: Use a fresh file, collect all available yellow herbs, finish every required physical region, let the result screen save, and preserve the cleared file. Do not substitute a New Game Plus finish.

levels.1: The standard route unlocks every post-game menu needed for the wider checklist.
levels.2: Finish a fresh Normal file and create its cleared-game save.
levels.3: Complete the main route on Normal, visit both sides of the major fork across separate backups, retain a pre-final-transition save, and accept the cleared-file prompt. Confirm Professional, bonus modes, Movie Browser, Matilda, Infinite Launcher, and the first costume set become available.

levels.1: The highest campaign setting gates one exclusive weapon.
levels.2: After Normal, begin Professional from New Game rather than New Game Plus.
levels.3: Use a separate Professional file, plan ammunition and merchant upgrades, protect the merchant because he does not respawn on this setting, finish the route, and save the clear. Start a cleared-file continuation and confirm the P.R.L. 412 is available.

levels.1: The cleared file is where the expensive and special campaign weapons can be demonstrated.
levels.2: Load a Normal clear, carry its inventory forward, and finish one New Game Plus cycle.
levels.3: Buy Matilda and Infinite Launcher, bring every fully upgraded retained weapon, equip both costume sets on separate reloads, test each unlock, and complete the cycle. Preserve the original Normal clear before making purchases.

levels.1: A finite set of yellow herbs expands the player and companion gauges.
levels.2: Combine every obtainable yellow herb with green or green-plus-red healing before use.
levels.3: Never sell a yellow herb. Pair each with green, adding red when convenient, then consume only while healing is useful. Use the chapter-end status screen and the final pre-transition backup to confirm the player's gauge reaches its cap; maximize the companion gauge where her route permits.

items.label: Complete Both Sides of the Rural Fork

levels.1: One mid-route choice makes two physical encounter paths mutually exclusive in a single pass.
levels.2: Back up before the fork and clear both the left and right routes.
levels.3: Take one branch through its exit, save evidence of its treasure and encounters, restore the fork backup, and clear the other. Continue the master file only after both branches and their unique pickups are recorded.

save_backup.title: Keep Normal and Professional clears
save_backup.why: Each gates different menus and weapons.

point_of_no_return.title: Last industrial vehicle route
point_of_no_return.warning: Finish collectible and merchant work before committing to the closing sequence.

areas.name: Mechanical Secrets and Variant Treasures
areas.location_cue: The rural well and basin, lakeside dock, church exterior, merchant stalls, and treasure-combination screen.

levels.1: A hanging treasure can be dirtied by careless timing.
levels.2: Shoot the support before dropping the pendant so the well is covered.
levels.3: Close the well lid by shooting its prop, then shoot the hanging pendant. Pick up the clean version and compare its sale value; reload if it lands in the dirty water.

levels.2: Close the basin lid before shooting down the watch.
